read: [02:54] Amal: Hello. .. [59:55] Amal: Bye. (all 623 turns, lines 1-625)
coverage_note: 36:27-42:30 is Latin transliteration (rows there keep her Latin). 09:32-13:48 is mostly English (Meet/computer setup), 29:00-31:10 and 40:42-42:30 are English grammar talk. Early lines 03:31-04:19 are garbled by the engine (مهمتي, بابا جان من ميرم بيته سريع, جان ملت) and were not scored. 32:07 'مناسبة' is almost surely the engine mishearing معصبة (she said Perfect) - not scored. 07:45 wrong clock time (تلاتة for تنتين) is a fact slip, not language. 08:59 مش مغيمة was NOT written: her sheet has 'it's cloudy | M8ayyme | مغيمة'. 33:57 he answered for himself when she asked what SHE does (هي شو بتعمل) - comprehension slip, not written. 43:18 'What, what?' on بتخططوا - he then produced بخطط, so not written as a didn't-know. 04:04 'the word for productive never made my cards' - no Arabic attempt, no supply from her, not written. Pronunciation left out per S4: مني for منيح (03:45), ثمانية/تمانين, يفيكي (59:42), bindar/bindir (37:03), nakun/nkun (39:35). Self-fixes left out: noodles→مكرونة (06:50), هو→هما at 19:32, مظلوم→مظلومين (52:15), بتأسف→بتتأسف (34:03), sayye→sayyein (40:04).

rows.medi_said: بس إحنا بدأ...
rows.why: He said 'we' then the bare past بدأ with no subject ending; she recast with the -na ending and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: بدأنا a marketing project who who لازم اشتغلت كتير
rows.why: 'I had to work a lot' needs kaan + laazem and a bare present verb after laazem; he put a past verb after a bare laazem; she recast and he repeated.
rows.english: I had to work a lot

rows.medi_said: مش مغني، مغـ، مغـ.
rows.why: He said مغني (singer) for مغيم (cloudy); she supplied مغيم and told him مغني is singer.

rows.medi_said: درجة حرارة.
rows.why: Idafa: the second noun takes el-; sheet row 'temperature | Darjet el-7araara | درجة الحرارة'; she recast and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: درجة الحرارة حوالين، تمنتاش.
rows.why: He said 18 (تمنتاش) for the temperature meaning 80; she echoed it as a question and he fixed to تمانين (sheet: eighteen tamanta3sh / eighty tamanin).

rows.medi_said: ما زبت. زبت is... oh my God, what was زبت؟
rows.amal_said: ما زبت. It-- معنى it didn't work out.
rows.right: ما زبت = it didn't work out
rows.why: Meaning check: he could not recall ما زبت and guessed 'it's okay, positive'; she supplied the meaning (sheet: zabe6 = to work out).

rows.medi_said: الـ Google Meet، بقدر، understand. بقدر، آ-آآآ، تفهم-
rows.why: Subject is Google Meet (he), so the verb must be يفهم not تفهم; she recast and he continued with يفهم.

rows.medi_said: يفهم عربي، بس ما، آآآم، م-م-ما، ما يقدر أكتب عربي.
rows.why: Subject is still Google Meet (he): أكتب is the I-form and يقدر lacks the present b- after ما; she let it pass (my reading).

rows.medi_said: هو راح، يأتي، راح ي-يأ-- ي-يأتينا-
rows.why: He meant 'it will bring us the translation'; يأتي is MSA 'come', not Levantine 'bring' (يجيب); she only echoed the word (my reading).
rows.english: it will bring us the translation

rows.medi_said: الـ تاني مشكلة. No.
rows.amal_said: تاني، تاني مشكلة or المشكلة التانية
rows.why: Adjective goes after the noun, el- on both; she gave المشكلة التانية and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: إنه احنا، نكتب في، Arabic or English letters.
rows.why: After إنه the b- stays (bucket B3 'KEEP it after enno'); he dropped it; she let it pass (my reading).
rows.english: that we write in English letters

rows.medi_said: يتعبك هذي الـ... That's been، I don't remember. أنا ما بـ-- ما، ما بتذكر، هذي الكلمة.
rows.amal_said: فترة means while, a while or period of time.
rows.why: He said he does not remember the word فترة; she supplied the meaning (didn't-know).

rows.medi_said: So what, what makes you sad at this time?
rows.why: He read بتعبك as 'makes you sad'; she corrected to 'tired' and walked him through بي-تعب-ك.

rows.medi_said: okay, tell me... Tell me كم مرة الجملة؟
rows.why: He wanted 'say the sentence one more time'; كم مرة = how many times (sheet 'how many times | Kam marra') vs 'one more time | Kaman marra'; she just repeated the sentence.
rows.english: say the sentence one more time

rows.medi_said: لما، أشتغل مع إي- عيلتنا كتير. و... هو، هما ما، ما، ما يخلصوا.
rows.why: Ordinary present 'they don't finish' needs the b- (ما بيخلصوا); she echoed and ticked it; he himself says ما بيخلصوا at 22:48.

rows.medi_said: وأنا لازم كل اليوم، أطلبهم أو أطلب-- is it أطلب لهم or أطلبهم؟
rows.why: طلب takes من (sheet 'i order/request/ask for | Ana ba6lub (min)'); he offered -hom and la-hom, she supplied منهم.
rows.english: I have to ask them (all day)

rows.medi_said: كام... كاملة؟
rows.why: He did not know كاملة in her question الجملة كاملة; she explained (didn't-know).

rows.medi_said: أنا بتعب كتير لما عيلتنا-- عيلتي، اللي، أشتغل معهم. و هو...
rows.why: The family members are plural, so the pronoun is هما not هو; she recast and he continued with هما.

rows.medi_said: هما ما بيخلصوا اشتغلتهم.
rows.why: He used the verb اشتغلت as the noun 'their work'; she supplied the noun شغلهم and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: شغلهم. و، لازم، لازم أطلب، أطلبهم-
rows.why: Same D2 slip again 2 minutes after 20:48: طلب takes من; she recast منهم and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: أطلب منهم كتير إنو، يخلص، يخلصهم؟
rows.why: The object 'it' (their work, singular) rides on the verb as -o, and the verb is plural يخلصوا; he put -hom; she gave يخلصوه (he then said يخلصوهم).

rows.medi_said: بتضل تعصب، تعصب، زمان طويل.
rows.amal_said: خطيبتي ما بتضل تعصب. ... it's angry, not to get angry. It's the adjective.
rows.why: 'Doesn't stay angry' needs the participle/adjective معصبة, not the verb تعصب; she named the rule and prompted him to fix it.

rows.medi_said: بتضل تعصب، تعصب، زمان طويل.
rows.why: زمان is 'long ago' (sheet 'a long time ago | Min zamaan'); 'for a long time' is لوقت طويل (sheet 'for a long time | la-wa2et taweel'); she recast and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: it's أنا بـ بنزبط. Is it b- بنزبطها؟
rows.why: He reached for زبط (fix / work out) for 'I make her happy'; the word is ببسطها (sheet 'it causes happiness | Byebse6'); she supplied it.

rows.medi_said: إذا أناaa, بحكيلها.
rows.why: After إذا the b- drops; he kept it and she only echoed the word (my reading; her prompt was 'if I told her').

rows.medi_said: أنا أعمل، ب- أ- أ- أعمل؟ بـ... أعمل. أعمل غلط. أنا-
rows.why: The sentence was 'I did something wrong' (past); he offered the bare present أعمل, she prompted 'I did... What's I made-', he asked عملت or خليت, she confirmed عملت.

rows.medi_said: So ما, ما بتضل معصب؟
rows.why: خطيبتي is feminine so the adjective is معصبة; she recast and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: بأسف
rows.why: For 'I apologize' he built بأسف from أسف (sheet 'sorry | aasef'); she said 'very close' and he arrived at بتأسف at 30:00, which she confirmed (he had asked for 'apologies' at 26:49).

rows.medi_said: لما، أتأس-- أت-- أتأسف.
rows.amal_said: And أتأسف takes لا so to her, أتأسف لها.
rows.why: She added the fixed preposition لـ before he finished the phrase; he had not yet said it wrong, so this is closer to a didn't-know than an error.

rows.medi_said: okay. so لما أنا، لما أنا بأعمل غلط، إشي غلط.
rows.why: After لما the b- drops (لما أعمل); he kept it and she ticked the line (my reading).

rows.medi_said: إن، إنتي ما-
rows.why: Talking about his fiancée he said 'you' (إنتي); she recast هي and he said 'هي، sorry'.

rows.medi_said: وقت كتير.
rows.why: 'A long time' is وقت طويل (sheet 'for a long time | la-wa2et taweel'), not وقت كتير; she said لا and gave طويل; he repeated.

rows.medi_said: و أنا، أنا، بس-- بس بت، أنا بس بتها.
rows.why: He could not produce ببسطها and ended on the non-word بتها; she supplied it and he said 'I hate this verb' (may be an S5 stumble rather than a vocab miss).

rows.medi_said: عتيته أنا، بنت-- بنتطلع، بنتطلع بنات أخوي-
rows.amal_said: Yeah, we say we take care of. / ‹Bindir›.
rows.why: He used بنتطلع (we look at) for 'we watch / babysit'; she queried بنطلع؟, said 'we say we take care of' and built bindir balna 3ala (sheet 'i take care of | Ana badir baali').
rows.english: we take care of my brother's daughters

rows.medi_said: Wouldn't it be ‹balhom› 'cause we're watching the kids?
rows.amal_said: No, we are... Still this is part of the verb. ... ‹bindir balna›, but then ‹fi› preposition after
rows.why: The ending on baal points to the subject (we -> balna), not the object; she said no and explained the object comes after a preposition.

rows.medi_said: So is it ‹yahom›?
rows.why: The object of ndir balna is introduced by 3ala, not iyyaa; she supplied 3ala.

rows.medi_said: ‹Alayhom›.
rows.why: A noun follows (binat akhui), so the preposition takes no pronoun ending; she said '3ala still' and he produced 3ala binat akhui.

rows.medi_said: ooh, I wanna say both of us. Do I just say ‹tinen›? Or-
rows.why: He asked how to say 'both of us'; she supplied ahna il tinen (didn't-know).

rows.medi_said: ‹Ahna il tinen›, ‹bin khaf, bin khaf min, is it ‹nakun ahel›?
rows.amal_said: Oh, here ‹hala ma btihtaj min›. ‹Bin khaf nakun›.
rows.why: bnkhaf min takes a noun; before a verb clause there is no min; she said 'here it doesn't need min' and he said bin khaf nikun.

rows.medi_said: Is, ‹isma›.
rows.why: Asked for 'name/noun' he said isma (his name); the bare word is ism (sheet 'noun | Esem'); she corrected.

rows.medi_said: بخوفنا.
rows.why: 'It scares us' is 3rd person بيخوفنا; بخوفنا is 'I scare us'; she said ممتاز (may be a dropped ي in the transcript).

rows.medi_said: إحنا، إحنا بنخ-- بنخط. Ben-- it's just بنخط، right?
rows.why: He asked whether 'we plan' is بنخط; the verb is خطط (sheet 'i plan | Ana ba5a66et'); بنخط is a different word; she corrected (could also be read as F3 shadda).

rows.medi_said: بنخطط. اه، يكونوا أهل.
rows.why: Subject is إحنا, so ykoon takes the we-form نكون; she recast, he tried يكون then fixed to نكون.

rows.medi_said: على كلٍ. على كلٍ شو، اه، شو، اه، بعصب، بعصب. I'm asking you.
rows.amal_said: let's not use it I think. بلاش. Sounds wrong. ... you would say بشكل عام.
rows.why: He used the Farsi-style على كلٍ / الكل for 'in general'; she said it sounds wrong and gave بشكل عام.
rows.english: in general, what makes you angry

rows.medi_said: لازم يكون issue سيء. سيء كتير.
rows.why: English 'issue' inside an Arabic sentence; مشكلة is on the sheet ('no problem | mesh mushkelah | مش مشكلة') and he used it at 15:31; but Amal herself said 'issue' at 48:23, so low.
rows.english: it has to be a really bad issue

rows.medi_said: عشان، اه، بعصب
rows.why: After عشان the b- drops; she recast أعصب, he asked 'عشان gets rid of be?' and repeated عشان أعصب.

rows.medi_said: ولا إشي، ولا إشي بيعص-- بعصبني
rows.why: Subject is ولا إشي (it), so the verb is 3rd person بيعصبني; he ended on بعصبني (I-form); she recast and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: هي، آآآه. She doesn't get-- هي ما، ما تعصب
rows.why: Plain present negative keeps the b- (ما بتعصب); she recast and he repeated هي ما بتعصب.

rows.medi_said: ما-- هي ما بتعصب، آآآه، سهل كمان
rows.why: He said سهل (easy) meaning 'quickly'; she prompted the English 'quickly' and he produced بسرعة (sheet 'quickly / hurry up | Bsur3a').
rows.english: she doesn't get angry quickly either

rows.medi_said: إحنا مظلوم
rows.amal_said: Well, that's not the same meaning. هذا مش نفس المعنى بالعربي ... a good word for this would be رايق
rows.why: He used مظلوم in its Farsi sense (calm, unreactive); in Arabic it means oppressed; she said it's not the same meaning and gave رايق.

rows.medi_said: مظلوم يعني، آآآه، مش صوت، آآآه، طويل، وما، ما بنعصب
rows.why: 'Not loud' is صوت عالي (sheet 'loud/high volume | Soat 3aali'); he said صوت طويل (long voice); she was busy with مظلوم and let it pass.

rows.medi_said: لما أنا لما أزآن.
rows.why: He misheard her زهقان (bored) as أزآن and repeated it; she said no and re-said زهقان (sheet 'bored | Zahqaan').

rows.medi_said: زهآن. زهآن. بس، آه، لما بزهأ.
rows.why: After لما the b- drops; she recast لما أزهق and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: أنا بكرى أو، أو. Oh, I can say ولا right؟ ولا،
rows.amal_said: أو؟ ... ولا is used more for options يعني.
rows.why: He wanted 'or' in a statement and proposed ولا; she queried أو? and explained ولا is for either-or options; he went on with أو.

rows.medi_said: أغو، أغير الجو.
rows.why: Ordinary present 'I change scenery' takes the b- (sheet 'Ba8ayyer jaw'); he said bare أغير; she recast بغير جو.
rows.english: I get a change of scenery

rows.medi_said: بغير الجو.
rows.why: The set phrase is بغير جو without el- (sheet 'i change scenery | Ba8ayyer jaw | بغير جو'); she said 'No ال' (he still repeated الجو at 58:26).
rows.english: I get a change of scenery

rows.medi_said: عملنا تمرين كتير.
rows.why: 'A lot of exercises' would be the plural تمارين; she answered عنجد and let it pass (my reading; singular may be acceptable as a mass noun).
rows.english: we did a lot of exercise

rows.medi_said: أنا شربت قهوة مكينة وماء كتير.
rows.why: MSA ماء instead of her مي (sheet 'water | Mayy | مي'); she let it pass.
rows.english: I drank machine coffee and lots of water

rows.medi_said: اليوم بلبس blouze شوي بنية وبنطلون أزرق فاتح.
rows.why: Transcribed in Latin as 'blouze' inside an Arabic sentence; her sheet has 'shirt / blouse | Blooze | بلوزة'; he may actually have said her بلوزة, so low.
rows.english: today I'm wearing a slightly brown blouse

rows.medi_said: أنا صحيت على ثمانية.
rows.why: Clock time is el-saa3a + number (sheet 'the time is 2:00 | Elsaa3a tentain'); he said 'on eight'; she moved on (my reading; على الساعة is also heard).
